name: Voice of Bwonsamdi explodes on Shadow Puppet hits (#12787)
contract: #12787: Shadow Puppets did not trigger Voice of Bwonsamdi. Voice 801716 reads 'Dealing periodic damage
unleashes a trapped voodoo spirit at enemies', and Shadow Puppets 500015 is a periodic aura whose ticks fire
Shadow Puppet 802745 at the target every 750 ms. The server sends those bolts as direct magic-class damage,
so Voice's periodic-only proc flags never saw them. With Voice active and nothing else dealing damage, the
Witch Doctor must deal Trapped Spirits 504452 damage to the target after Shadow Puppets lands. Before Shadow
Puppets there is no 504452 damage, so the explosions come from the puppet hits.

steps.label: Control: no Trapped Spirits damage before Shadow Puppets
